# EXP-003 — public evidence (sanitized)

This directory contains the **public, sanitized** mirror of the Session 001
evidence for EXP-003 (Nebius AI Cloud · NVIDIA H200 · vLLM · Qwen3-0.6B).

The private originals are preserved outside the public repository. They are
**not** committed. Everything here was generated by
`scripts/sanitize-evidence.py` from the private session directory.

## What was removed

| Category | Treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Nebius instance hostname | `computeinstance-<redacted>` |
| GPU serial number | `<redacted-gpu-serial>` |
| GPU UUID | `GPU-<redacted>` |
| GPU PDI | `<redacted>` |
| Host process PID | `<redacted>` |
| Local user home path | `/home/<user>/...` |
| Docker bridge IPs | `<private-ip>` |
| Container ID, sandbox key, overlay paths | Removed from `vllm-inspect.json` |

No API keys, SSH private keys, tokens, passwords or cloud credentials were
present in the session evidence. The scan and its result are recorded in
`sanitization-report.json`.

## Excluded from publication

| File | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `evidence/nebius-capacity/resource-advice.json` | Account/tenant metadata not needed for the experiment |
| `reports/gpu-quotas.json` | Account-specific GPU quota data |
| `evidence/nebius-h200/exp003-evidence.tar.gz` | Duplicate archive of the unredacted originals |
| `resource-advice.jsonmkdir` | Empty accidental file |

## Contents

```
session-001/
  benchmark_api.py                     # original benchmark script
  evidence/
    benchmarks/qwen3-0.6b.json         # 10-request benchmark result
    dcgm-level1.txt                    # DCGM level-1 diagnostic: PASS
    gpu-after-pytorch.txt              # nvidia-smi after PyTorch workload
    gpu-baseline.txt                   # nvidia-smi + memory + filesystem baseline
    nvidia-smi-full.txt                # full GPU inventory (identifiers redacted)
    python-packages.txt                # CUDA/PyTorch package versions
    qwen3-inference.json               # one chat-completion response
    session-ended-utc.txt              # session end timestamp
    storage.txt                        # filesystem usage after model download
    vllm-image-digest.json             # image digest (registry)
    vllm-image-id.txt                  # image digest (local)
    vllm-inspect.json                  # sanitized container configuration
    vllm.log                           # vLLM startup and request log
```

## Integrity

`MANIFEST.sha256` lists the SHA-256 of every public file in this directory.
`sanitization-report.json` records input and output hashes, the transformations
applied, the exclusions, and the residual-pattern scan.

## Reproduce the sanitization

```bash
python3 scripts/sanitize-evidence.py \
  --input /path/to/private/session-001 \
  --output evidence/public/session-001 \
  --report evidence/public/sanitization-report.json \
  --clean
```
